definition: to spend time with your friends
exampleTranslation: Thứ Bảy tôi gặp bạn bè.

definition: to come together with someone as planned
exampleTranslation: Mình gặp nhau lúc sáu giờ nhé.

definition: to spend time with friends in a relaxed way
exampleSentence: I hang out with friends after work.
exampleTranslation: Sau giờ làm tôi đi chơi với bạn bè.

definition: to talk to someone you have not seen for some time
translation: gặp gỡ nói chuyện, hàn huyên với ai
exampleSentence: I want to catch up with my old friends.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn gặp gỡ hàn huyên với những người bạn cũ.

definition: to drink a cup of coffee with someone
exampleSentence: Let's have a coffee after class.
exampleTranslation: Tan học mình đi uống cà phê nhé.

definition: to ask someone to come to your home
exampleSentence: I invited my neighbours over for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mời hàng xóm sang nhà ăn tối.

definition: to decide what you will do in the future
exampleSentence: Are you making plans for the weekend?
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần này bạn có kế hoạch gì chưa?

definition: to agree on a time and place to meet
exampleSentence: We arranged to meet at the cinema.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi hẹn gặp nhau ở rạp chiếu phim.

definition: to say that something you planned will not happen
exampleSentence: We had to cancel our plans because of the rain.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi phải hủy kế hoạch vì trời mưa.

definition: to not come to meet someone as you promised
exampleSentence: He stood me up on Friday.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Sáu bạn ấy cho tôi leo cây.

definition: to move your hand to say goodbye
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ vẫy tay chào tạm biệt.

definition: to tell someone your name when you meet
exampleSentence: Let me introduce myself. I'm Lan.
exampleTranslation: Để tôi tự giới thiệu. Tôi là Lan.

definition: to learn about someone by spending time with them
exampleSentence: I'd like to get to know my neighbours.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn làm quen với hàng xóm.

definition: to eat an evening meal in a restaurant
exampleSentence: We go out for dinner on Fridays.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Sáu chúng tôi đi ăn tối ngoài.

definition: to go to a bar or café to have a drink
exampleSentence: Do you want to go out for a drink?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn đi uống nước không?

definition: to sleep at someone else's house for a night
exampleSentence: My friend stayed over last night.
exampleTranslation: Tối qua bạn tôi ngủ lại nhà.

definition: to invite people to your home for a meal
exampleSentence: We are hosting a dinner on Saturday.
exampleTranslation: Thứ Bảy chúng tôi đãi tiệc tối ở nhà.
